description_en: Describes the databases in a PolarDB on ENS cluster
kebab_example: aliyun polardb describe-databases-zonal --db-cluster-id pc-00000000000000 --db-name test_db --page-number 1 --page-size 30 --max-results 10 --next-token 212db86sca4384811e0b5e8707e000000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeDatabasesZonal

parameters.help_en: The page number. The value must be an integer that is greater than 0 and does not exceed the maximum value of the Integer data type. The default value is 1
parameters.help_zh: 页码，取值范围为大于 0 但不超过 Integer 最大值的整数，默认值为 1
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en:
The number of entries to return on each page. Valid values:

- 30

- 50

- 100

The default value is 30
parameters.help_zh:
每页记录数，取值范围如下：

- 30
- 50
- 100

默认值为 30
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The maximum number of entries to return for the current request
parameters.help_zh: 本次读取的最大数据量
parameters.name: max_results

parameters.help_en: The query token. This is the NextToken value from the previous API call. If there are no more results, do not specify this parameter
parameters.help_zh: 查询凭证（token），取值为上一次api调用返回的nexttoken参数值。如果没有下一个查询，请不传
parameters.name: next_token
